bounded_primary_sources.title: Glyphs: Drawing good paths
bounded_primary_sources.applied: Separate intentional corner nodes from smooth curves, use two explicit controls for each cubic, avoid redundant points and close contours. Keep component outlines separately editable.

bounded_primary_sources.title: Glyphs Handbook: Drawing Paths
bounded_primary_sources.applied: Use line segments for cut faces and cubic segments for gentle body curvature, with explicit on-curve nodes and off-curve handles.

bounded_primary_sources.title: Figma Developer Docs: VectorPath data
bounded_primary_sources.applied: Output supported absoluteM/L/C/Z path commands andNONZERO winding information so the outline remains directly editable in Figma.
